summary: SES S.A. announced final results of its cash tender offer for its €500,000,000 0.875% guaranteed notes due November 2027 (XS2075811781). Valid tenders reached €363,397,000, and the issuer set the Final Acceptance Amount at that level, accepting all tendered notes in full with no pro rata scaling. Pricing produced a 3.442% purchase yield and 97.330% purchase price, plus accrued interest of €8.08 per €1,000. Settlement is expected October 7, 2026, subject to the New Issue Condition; €136,603,000 remains outstanding and accepted notes will be cancelled. BNP Paribas, ING, LBBW and Mizuho acted as dealer managers; Kroll as tender agent. Watch the new-issue financing condition and any further liability-management steps.
